_doc: Day -> split for merge.py (see polyrec/splits.py). 'frozen' must equal data/build.py SPLIT_DAYS and never changes. Recorded days use 'days' (single dates or 'a..b' ranges; value train|val|test|exclude|auto) else 'default'. 'auto' = cycle[(day - anchor) mod len]; an 8-day cycle rotates val/test through the weekdays. Every assignment merge.py uses is pinned in lock_file; a day that was ever test can never move.
